title: From the top 10 graduate students in the Political Science department (wher
question: From the top 10 graduate students in the Political Science department (where the department is degree granting) with the highest number of subjects taken in the term '2016SP' (where each subject has more than 1 total unit), display each student's first name, last name, email address, department name, school name, the maximum department budget code for each student considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by last name, the total number of subjects taken by the student in that term, and, for each such student, the subject ID, subject title, and the running sum of total units for their subjects within each school name group ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH polsci AS (
  SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, DEPT_BUDGET_CODE
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT
  WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
),
subj AS (
  SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, SCHOOL_NAME, TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY
  WHERE TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND TOTAL_UNITS > 1
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT s.FULL_NAME, s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
         p.DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.SCHOOL_NAME, p.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE,
         COUNT(*) AS total_subjects
  FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s
  JOIN polsci p ON s.DEPARTMENT = p.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  JOIN subj x ON 1=1
  WHERE s.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G'
  GROUP BY s.FULL_NAME, s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
           p.DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.SCHOOL_NAME, p.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE
  ORDER BY total_subjects DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT t.*,
         MAX(t.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (
           PARTITION BY t.FULL_NAME
           ORDER BY t.LAST_NAME
           ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING
         ) AS max_budget_code
  FROM top10 t
),
subj_ranked AS (
  SELECT r.FULL_NAME, r.FIRST_NAME, r.LAST_NAME, r.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
         r.DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.SCHOOL_NAME, r.max_budget_code, r.total_subjects,
         s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE,
         SUM(s.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (
           PARTITION BY r.FULL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME
           ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_ID
           ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
         ) AS running_units
  FROM ranked r
  JOIN subj s ON 1=1
)
SELECT FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, EMAIL_ADDRESS, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME,
       max_budget_code, total_subjects, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, running_units
FROM subj_ranked
ORDER BY FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_ID

    msd.FIRST_NAME,
    msd.LAST_NAME,

  WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G'
    AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'
    AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'

  SELECT
    FULL_NAME,
    FIRST_NAME,
    LAST_NAME,
    EMAIL_ADDRESS,

  FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY
  WHERE TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND TOTAL_UNITS > 1
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT s.FULL_NAME, s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
         p.DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.SCHOOL_NAME, p.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE,
         COUNT(*) AS total_subjects
  FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s
  JOIN polsci p ON s.DEPARTMENT = p.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  JOIN subj x ON 1=1
  WHERE s.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G'
  GROUP BY s.FULL_NAME, s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
           p.DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.SCHOOL_NAME, p.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE
  ORDER BY total_subjects DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT t.*,
         MAX(t.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (
           PARTITION BY t.FULL_NAME
           ORDER BY t.LAST_NAME
           ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING
         ) AS max_budget_code
  FROM top10 t
),
subj_ranked AS (
  SELECT r.FULL_NAME, r.FIRST_NAME, r.LAST_NAME, r.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
         r.DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.SCHOOL_NAME, r.max_budget_code, r.total_subjects,
         s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE,
         SUM(s.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (
           PARTITION BY r.FULL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME
           ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_ID
           ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
         ) AS running_units
  FROM ranked r
  JOIN subj s ON 1=1
)
SELECT FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, EMAIL_ADDRESS, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME,
       max_budget_code, total_subjects, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, running_units
